fairness_contract_review.KG_to_answer_boundary: Selected records map only to original page chunks; structured values, fact IDs, rendered evidence cards and reference explanations must not enter answer prompts.
fairness_contract_review.RAG_boundary: Frozen global BM25/top-four with generic ontology expansion, no qid-to-source or target-page routing.
fairness_contract_review.canonical_claim_limit: Free-form Chinese/English synonyms and equivalent units can differ from the reference representation; strict field equality is not semantic accuracy.
fairness_contract_review.common_answer_generator: One fixed unadapted base model with identical prompt, schema and output/context budget for all arms.
fairness_contract_review.comparison_scope: Curated KG-assisted retrieval versus raw-text RAG with different representation/training histories; not isolated algorithm causality.
fairness_contract_review.correct_answer_from_wrong_record: Possible because several facts share a full-page chunk; selection and final answer scores are distinct.
fairness_contract_review.final_pipeline_freeze_and_scoring_gate: Parent must bind final code/protocol and completed preflight; this data audit does not substitute for those runtime gates.
fairness_contract_review.preflight_weight_integrity_review: CPU full-SHA attestation, per-job size/mtime/ctime checks and final full-SHA required; attestation must be protocol-bound.
fairness_contract_review.reference_access_order: Freeze all five selector and six answer outputs; replay/verify evidence and completion; only then score with references.
report_separately: Blinded semantic support and natural-language fidelity

limitations: AI-only source interpretation, not independently human-verified equipment truth.
Four source/family groups are the correlation units; the 24 questions are not 24 independent sources.
Three device families appear in historical collected corpus, while old debug sources/families are excluded.
Manufacturer publications report specifications, not independent measurements or guaranteed current equipment behavior.
Questions are source-bound single-intent lookup tasks, not multi-hop reasoning, unsupported-query robustness or general radar expertise.
No source-silent unknowns or invented events were added; this packet cannot validate unknown-answer behavior.
Text extraction retains spacing and ligature artifacts; source hashes and original PDF layouts remain authoritative.
The curated KB is a subset with distractors, whereas RAG sees full pages; record selection and answer generation require separate reporting.
No favorable-seed selection, extra training or post-score prompt/retrieval tuning is authorized by this audit.

semantic_checks: 发射机参数与天线/系统输入功率分开；峰值和平均功率未混合。
平均功率绑定占空比；离散脉宽没有改成连续区间。
735C当前官方版本与历史700C/735C第三方版本分别保留，不合并频率。
典型工作距离和技术距离为两种量，没有当作同一连续范围。
频段原文保留为文本，没有推断为精确单频；峰值功率保留双波束原文限定，不推算合计或单束功率。
启动/工作温度分别保留；最大PRF和最大观测距离作为带max的文本干扰记录，不冒充精确无条件常数。
原始PDF视觉确认两个型号列；机器layout文本保留列位置，供所有回答路线共同使用。
条件关系保留一对多配置；共享环境行按scanner/display解释，未误当作型号左右列。
